title: Audit source table add visibility fix
summary: Fixed Reports Audit source-table visibility after adding sources by rendering backend source command results with table-local status and adding the audit source routes to the Tauri backend contract list.
reason: Operators could add a source while the Locations table still displayed no rows or no actionable error, making saved audit sources look like transient form input.
behavior_before: Add Source could leave the Locations table stale or empty, and source-command failures could be hidden outside the table panel during active audit refreshes. The Tauri required route list also omitted the audit source read/write routes.
behavior_after: Add Source selects and renders the returned source rows immediately, source-command failures appear in the Locations panel, and the shell contract requires the audit source GET/POST routes exposed by the Python API.
tests_added: Extended tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py to assert audit source command results update the table-local render/status path.
rollback_plan: Revert the auditCommands.js table-status handling, remove the audit source route entries from routes.rs, and remove the static assertion if the source table behavior must return to the previous implementation.
notes:
Keep audit source add/remove/scan feedback visible in the Locations table and render added sources after selecting them.
Add audit source read/write routes to the Tauri backend contract allowlist.
Assert audit source command results update the table-local status path.
Refresh generated summaries after the source, shell contract, and static test updates.
